me.name: Austin
me.bio: an indie Mac and Windows developer who builds tools that read Twitch and YouTube chat

products.ClipSpike: watches Twitch chat while you stream and saves the moments chat reacts to as 9:16 vertical clips; Windows app, 3 free clips a week, $39 once
products.StreamSpike: Mac app in development that finds chat spikes in a Twitch or YouTube VOD and shows what the streamer said at that moment
